author: Thaikadar.com (ٹھیکیدار)

sections.description:
Boto AI Pilot is an AI chatbot and lead generation assistant for WordPress. It helps businesses answer visitor questions about their services, pricing, FAQs, and contact information while turning interested visitors into leads.

Connect your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key, configure your business information, and add an AI-powered chat widget to your WordPress website.

Boto AI Pilot is designed for businesses, agencies, real estate websites, online stores, service providers, and anyone who wants to turn website visitors into conversations and potential customers.

Why Boto AI Pilot?

Instead of sending your entire business knowledge base to an AI model with every question, Boto AI Pilot uses intent detection to identify what the visitor is asking about and sends only the relevant information.

Common greetings, thanks, and high-confidence FAQ matches can be handled locally without an external AI API request.

If you do not configure an API key, the chatbot can still use its local keyword-matching system to answer questions based on the services and FAQs you configure.

You control which AI provider is used and provide your own API key.

Key Features

  • AI Chatbot for WordPress: Add an AI-powered conversational assistant to your website.
  • Lead Generation: Detect buying intent and present a lead form when visitors show interest.
  • OpenAI Support: Connect your own OpenAI API key for AI-powered responses.
  • Google Gemini Support: Use Google Gemini as an alternative AI provider.
  • Local Fallback: Continue answering basic questions using local keyword matching without an AI API key.
  • Cost-Conscious Context: Send only relevant business information to the AI model instead of your entire knowledge base.
  • Business Knowledge Base: Configure services, FAQs, contact information, and other business details.
  • Intent Detection: Identify questions about pricing, services, contact information, bookings, and other visitor needs.
  • Lead Inbox: Manage captured leads directly from your WordPress dashboard.
  • Lead Scoring: Review lead scores and conversation transcripts to identify promising prospects.
  • WhatsApp and Email Contact: Quickly contact captured leads using their available contact information.
  • Chat Transcripts: Review conversations associated with captured leads.
  • Site Content Scanner: Scan published WordPress Pages, Posts, and WooCommerce products and convert relevant information into editable context.
  • AI Persona: Configure the business category, assistant name, and conversational tone.
  • Multilingual Responses: Automatically respond in English, Roman Urdu, or Urdu script, or configure a preferred language.
  • Widget Customizer: Customize the widget color, position, avatar, and greeting message.
  • Setup Wizard: Configure the chatbot, business information, API provider, and widget settings through a guided setup process.
  • Open Source: Released under the GPLv2 or later license.

Use Cases

Boto AI Pilot can be used for:

  • Real estate websites
  • Property marketplaces
  • Digital marketing agencies
  • Software companies
  • Freelancers and consultants
  • E-commerce stores
  • WooCommerce websites
  • Restaurants and local businesses
  • Service-based businesses
  • Professional services
  • Lead generation websites
  • Business websites and landing pages

Third-Party Services

Boto AI Pilot can optionally connect to third-party AI services to generate conversational responses.

No visitor chat data is sent to an external AI service until the website administrator configures an API key in the plugin settings.

OpenAI API

  • Service Provider: OpenAI, L.L.C.
  • Purpose: Generate AI-powered responses to visitor questions.
  • Data Transmitted: Visitor chat messages and relevant business context configured by the website administrator.
  • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
  • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Gemini API

  • Service Provider: Google LLC
  • Purpose: Generate AI-powered responses to visitor questions.
  • Data Transmitted: Visitor chat messages and relevant business context configured by the website administrator.
  • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Only one configured AI provider is used for an individual response. The website administrator is responsible for their selected provider’s API usage, costs, and applicable terms.

Privacy

Boto AI Pilot does not require an external AI service to provide its basic local fallback functionality.

When an administrator configures OpenAI or Google Gemini, visitor chat messages and relevant business context may be transmitted to the selected provider to generate responses.

The plugin does not intentionally transmit WordPress passwords or WordPress user account credentials to these AI services.

Website administrators should review their privacy policy and the applicable terms and privacy policies of their selected AI provider before enabling AI services.
sections.installation:
1. Install Boto AI Pilot from the WordPress Plugins directory or upload the boto-ai-pilot plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Boto AI Pilot from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Run the Setup Wizard.
  5. Configure your business profile, services, FAQs, and widget settings.
  6. Optionally enter an OpenAI or Google Gemini API key.
  7. Save your settings.
  8. Visit your website and open the floating chatbot.
sections.faq:
Is Boto AI Pilot free and open source?

Yes. Boto AI Pilot is released under the GPLv2 or later license.

Do I need an OpenAI or Gemini API key?

No. The plugin includes a local keyword-matching fallback. An OpenAI or Google Gemini API key is required only for AI-powered conversational responses.

Can I use OpenAI?

Yes. You can connect your own OpenAI API key from the plugin settings.

Can I use Google Gemini?

Yes. Google Gemini is supported as an alternative AI provider.

Does Boto AI Pilot send visitor data to an AI service?

Only when the website administrator configures an OpenAI or Google Gemini API key. In that case, visitor messages and relevant configured business context may be sent to the selected provider to generate a response.

Can I use Boto AI Pilot for lead generation?

Yes. The plugin can detect visitor buying signals and display an in-chat lead form. Captured leads can be reviewed from the WordPress dashboard.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Boto AI Pilot can scan published WooCommerce products and use relevant product information as part of the chatbot’s configurable business context.

Can I customize the chatbot?

Yes. You can customize the chatbot’s name, tone, language, greeting, avatar, accent color, and screen position.

Does it support Urdu?

Yes. Boto AI Pilot can respond in English, Roman Urdu, or Urdu script, or use a configured language preference.

Can I use the plugin without an API key?

Yes. Without an external AI API key, the plugin can use its local keyword-matching fallback against the services and FAQs configured by the administrator.

Where are captured leads stored?

Captured leads are managed through the Boto AI Pilot section of your WordPress dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Removed the public-facing attribution and credit footer link from the chat widget.
  • Updated direct contact options to use the website’s configured phone, email, and homepage information.

1.1.0

  • Fixed chat footer layout and sticky positioning.
  • Improved mobile viewport responsiveness and full-screen behavior.
  • Improved pointer-events behavior and tab switching responsiveness.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added cost-conscious AI context system.
  • Added configurable business categories and AI persona.
  • Added reply language controls.
  • Added site content scanning.
  • Added OpenAI and Google Gemini support.
  • Added lead capture and lead management.
